entry.title: New: dsh-joi-channel-theme
entry.summary: Two-suit VTuber theme for Joi: Flowers and Library are separate token systems for light and dark, with a standing portrait and a whale girl napping on the headline of the new-session page, two chibi companions above the composer that follow the turn state, a duo sidebar mark, and a context meter shaped as a ripening mandarin; a third card returns the stock DeepSeek look with the plugin still installed. Exact install spec: dsh-joi-channel-theme. Source event: awesome-dsh-plugin/awesome-dsh-plugin; changed: listed.
